## Summary

Maggie, the SAGA texture-mapping unit, is programmed through registers at `$DFF250`–`$DFF28F`. This file gives the official names; the measured behaviour is in core/saga-3d-maggie/registers.md.

## Details

### Registers

| Address | Name | Access | Description (original) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$DFF250` | TEXTPT | W | 3D 32bit texture source |
| `$DFF254` | TEXDPT | W | 3D 32bit Destination Screen Addr |
| `$DFF258` | TEXZPT | W | 3D ZBuffer Addr |
| `$DFF25E` | TEXSTRT | W | 3D 16bit LEN and START  Bit15=0 = Start new job  Bit15=1 = Continue previous job  Bit10..0 = length in pixel |
| `$DFF260` | TEXMIP | W | 3D 16bit MIP texture size bit(3..0) ($A=1024/9=512/8=256/7=128/6=64/5=32)  Bit4='1' = AutoMipMapMode with Bit3-0 define max mip |
| `$DFF262` | TEXMODE | W | 3D 16bit MODE  (Bit0=use Bilienar)  (Bit1=use Zbuffer) (Bit2=select 16bit output)  (Bit3=inhibit Zbuffer write)  (Bit4=select 24bit output)  (Bit5=quadratic-mode)  (Bit7-6= BLENDMode "00" =COPY) (Bit7-6= BLENDMode "01" =ADD) (Bit7-6= BLENDMode "10" =MUL) |
| `$DFF266` | TEXDMOD | W | 3D 16bit signed Destination Step |
| `$DFF268` | TEXddUUuuuu | W | 3D 24bit ddUUuuuu (quadratic) |
| `$DFF26C` | TEXddVVvvvv | W | 3D 24bit ddVVvvvv (quadratic) |
| `$DFF270` | TEXUUuuuu | W | 3D 24bit UUuuuu |
| `$DFF274` | TEXVVvvvv | W | 3D 24bit VVvvvv |
| `$DFF278` | TEXdUUuuuu | W | 3D 24bit dUUuuuu |
| `$DFF27C` | TEXdVVvvvv | W | 3D 24bit dVVvvvv |
| `$DFF280` | TEXLight | W | 3D 16bit Light Ll |
| `$DFF282` | TEXdLight | W | 3D 16bit Light dLl |
| `$DFF284` | TEXLightcolor | W | 3D 32bit Light color |
| `$DFF288` | TEXZZzz | W | 3D 32bit ZZZZzzzz |
| `$DFF28C` | TEXdZZzz | W | 3D 32bit Delta ZZZZzzzz |

Offsets from `$DFF250`, for comparison with the measured layout in [registers.md](../saga-3d-maggie/registers.md):

| Offset | Name (original) |
|---|---|
| 0 | TEXTPT |
| 4 | TEXDPT |
| 8 | TEXZPT |
| 14 | TEXSTRT |
| 16 | TEXMIP |
| 18 | TEXMODE |
| 22 | TEXDMOD |
| 24 | TEXddUUuuuu |
| 28 | TEXddVVvvvv |
| 32 | TEXUUuuuu |
| 36 | TEXVVvvvv |
| 40 | TEXdUUuuuu |
| 44 | TEXdVVvvvv |
| 48 | TEXLight |
| 50 | TEXdLight |
| 52 | TEXLightcolor |
| 56 | TEXZZzz |
| 60 | TEXdZZzz |

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- Classic Amiga chipsets have no texture-mapping unit.

## Do / Don't

- DO prefer the library calls (maggie.library) to direct access to these registers: a best practice, not a forced rule (see [prefer-library-calls-for-saga-chips.md](../best-practices/prefer-library-calls-for-saga-chips.md)).
- DO write TEXSTRT (`$DFF25E`) last: it starts the span.
- DO check core/saga-3d-maggie/registers.md and its pitfalls for the measured behaviour.
